# Ashna Consulting

Ashna Consulting is a relocation and bureaucracy consulting agency based in Berlin, Germany. They specialize in helping expatriates and new residents navigate the complex German bureaucratic system.

## Services

- **The Berlin Starter Kit**: Anmeldung, bank accounts, SIM cards, health insurance orientation, Tax ID, and ARD/ZDF registration.
- **The Goodbye Germany Kit**: Abmeldung, contract cancellations, and refund advice (pension/tax).
- **Bureaucracy & Paperwork**: Visa and residence permit support, letter translation (Paperwork Rescue), and in-person assistance at authorities.
- **Education & Career**: Degree recognition, freelance/self-employment setup, and Ausbildung coaching.
- **Daily Life & Family**: Driving license support, appointment booking, family support (Kindergeld, Elterngeld), and housing application checks.
